source.scope: The decision evaluates this frozen executable/configuration tree. Later documentation commits do not retroactively become the tested source.

assessment: This composite engineering decision follows inspection of named assertions, actual archived SQL/native/lexical reports, kernel attribution and source hashes. A successful CI badge alone is insufficient. The individual normalized experiment reports were produced before this composite decision and deliberately do not declare P0 exit by themselves.

acceptance.evidence: Locked Rust 1.96.0, Edge 0.8.0, pgrx/cargo-pgrx 0.19.3 and PG17.11 build/install in four profiles; all 246 native package tuples and seven archive pins match. The conservative CPU admission and selected native-object audit pass on the recorded runner.
acceptance.limits: One frozen P0 platform and feature set; no generic x86_64, bit-identical binary, full ISA/link closure, complete license review or supported distribution claim.

acceptance.evidence: Fixed public variant/type inventory is mapped to the 54 IDs or explicit exclusions. Forty-three concrete shard method call bodies compile; the remaining refresh_with declaration has an explicit public-construction exclusion. Negative-input and public-lifecycle assertions execute in bounded children.
acceptance.limits: Public existence and compiled signatures do not establish all combinations. Native bit input, update-only Store/Delete/bootstrap and unavailable public WAL operations remain explicit exclusions or gaps.

acceptance.evidence: Twenty-seven ordinary named engine tests and the exact 16 smoke groups in each of four SQL profiles pass, including BM25/dense/sparse/MaxSim/prefetch/fusion/filter/group paths and the owned-child malformed-input matrix.
acceptance.limits: Synthetic semantics and input characterization; malformed values accepted by Edge still require a product adapter guard. No held-out retrieval-quality or product query claim.

acceptance.evidence: Independent BM25/text configuration, mixed-language defaults, phrase/array behavior and distinct token/keyword prefixes execute. The isolated Tantivy build and five semantic cases expose concrete F13-F20 gaps and support the owned pre-Alpha library decision in ADR0002/0004.
acceptance.limits: Tantivy is not adopted or linked with Edge/pgrx. Fixed-comparator quality, analyzer parity, work budgets, authorization and dual-engine lifecycle still gate adoption and Alpha.

acceptance.evidence: SQL profile totals 20/22/20/26, seven source/identity groups per profile, all three candidate-format groups, bounded owner IPC, queue cancellation, deadlines, same-backend SPI retry, and helper pipe totals 7/8 pass.
acceptance.limits: Superuser-only diagnostic fixtures; no production source privilege/RLS proof, catalog, stable persistent identity allocator, capture/backfill, ticket API or real source-table search.

acceptance.evidence: Owned panic/abort/SIGKILL, exact kernel OOM attribution, companion-session outcomes, owner replacement and the four dedicated disk/capacity profiles pass their characterization assertions. Dirty-generation refusal and complete-fixture fresh reconstruction execute without opening the old generation.
acceptance.limits: Direct-worker native failure causes PostgreSQL collateral recovery and is rejected as the product default. Controlled helper containment does not establish arbitrary-pressure isolation, dirty WAL replay, PG/Edge atomicity, live cutover or power-loss durability.

acceptance.evidence: Accept the same-package exec helper, ordinary EdgeShard public APIs, explicit flush before future exact-event ACK, and refusal/reconstruction of uncertain generations. The post-P0 module allocation and critical path retain source, lexical, security, recovery and release costs.
acceptance.limits: This is an engineering go to implement P1-P5; the selected protocol is not already implemented. Reopen the decision if future persistence, source retention, storage or containment gates fail.

follow_on_gates.P1: Production catalog, transactional capture, consistent backfill, persistent incarnation/revision/fingerprint arbitration, exact-event flush/ACK, post-commit tickets and crash cuts.
follow_on_gates.P2: Source-table text/balanced/precision search, shared analyzers, branch-wide authorization, results/grouping/fallback, frozen bilingual relevance and complete source-to-search example.
follow_on_gates.P3: Bounded resource policy, production rebuild/cutover, WAL admission/rotation, sustained performance, old/new index migration and executable rollback.
follow_on_gates.P4: All remaining advanced retrieval and F13-F20 lexical contracts, plus shared source/permission/lifecycle/fusion if a second engine is adopted.
follow_on_gates.P5: Installable supported packages, complete notices/license review, clean product journeys, upgrade/restore support and explicitly authorized publication.
follow_on_gates.M0_M1_M2: Optional local-model and supervised-ranking design requirements remain separate and unimplemented; offline BM25 and BYOV do not gain mandatory inference dependencies.

normalization.scope: Combines verified reports with an explicit scoped engineering judgment; performs no new engine, PostgreSQL or fault execution.
